Author: Anomaly
Name: Pet Service
Description: A private FFXIV tool for consensual pet/master roleplay and power dynamics. Masters manage prompts, routines, contact requests, locally garbled speech, and observed activity through Discord, the website, or the in-game Master page. Pets keep a local kill switch; ordinary game chat and conversation partners stay private.
Punchline: Consensual pet/master roleplay, messages, and shared routines.
Changelog: A familiar call opens a door before a whisper leaves. A voice may find a quieter place to settle. Returning to the same doorstep still leaves a ribbon behind.
